description: Bug zoo for the explain-failure and hint prompts. Each problem has three known-bad solutions with a labelled bug and the first failing test.

problems.title: Pair Sum
problems.statement: Return the indices of the two numbers in nums that add up to target. Each input has exactly one solution and you may not use the same index twice.
problems.signature: def pair_sum(nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]: ...

problems.title: Reverse String In Place
problems.statement: Reverse the characters of the input list in place and return it. Do not allocate a second list.

solutions.code:
def reverse_string(chars):
    left, right = 0, len(chars) - 1
    while left < right - 1:
        chars[left], chars[right] = chars[right], chars[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return chars

def reverse_string(chars):
    return list(reversed(chars))

def reverse_string(chars):
    left, right = 0, len(chars) - 1
    while left < right:
        chars[left], chars[right] = chars[right], chars[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return chars[0]

input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

problems.title: Binary Search

problems.signature: def search(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int: ...

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.statement: Return the largest sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray of nums.

solutions.code:
def max_subarray(nums):
    return max(nums)

def max_subarray(nums):
    best = 0
    current = 0
    for value in nums:
        current = max(value, current + value)
        best = max(best, current)
    return best

def max_subarray(nums):
    best = nums[1]
    current = nums[1]
    for value in nums[2:]:
        current = max(value, current + value)
        best = max(best, current)
    return best
